answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The river holds work receipts rather than names, so the raven of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, reduced by each unverified claim, each submission carries a fresh nonce. By the ridge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
